hints: Focus on who is the base and who is the acid here, remember a base donates a lone pair and an acid accepts it.
Count the bonding pairs and lone pairs on nitrogen in $\text{NH}_3$ and then in $\text{NH}_4^+$, this tells you the shape of each.
Link each shape to its bond angle, then compare $\text{NH}_4^+$ with $\text{CH}_4$ which both have four bonding pairs and no lone pairs.
walkthrough:
**Write the acid-base reaction**

Think of this simply. Ammonia has a lone pair, so it acts as the base. HCl provides $\text{H}^+$, so it acts as the acid.

Chemical equation:
$$\text{NH}_3 + \text{HCl} \rightarrow \text{NH}_4^+ + \text{Cl}^-$$

**Find the shapes using VSEPR**

In $\text{NH}_3$, nitrogen has 3 bonding pairs and 1 lone pair. That gives trigonal pyramidal shape with angle about $107^{\circ}$.

In $\text{NH}_4^+$, the lone pair is now used to form a dative bond to $\text{H}^+$. Nitrogen now has 4 bonding pairs and 0 lone pairs. That gives tetrahedral shape with angle $109.5^{\circ}$.

**Compare with methane**

In $\text{CH}_4$, carbon also has 4 bonding pairs and 0 lone pairs. So it is also tetrahedral with angle $109.5^{\circ}$.

That means $\text{NH}_4^+$ and $\text{CH}_4$ have the same shape and the same bond angle.

options.A: Incorrect. It is ammonia, $\text{NH}_3$, that is basic because it has a lone pair to donate. The ammonium ion, $\text{NH}_4^+$, is its conjugate acid and can donate a proton, so it is acidic, not basic.
options.B: Incorrect. This reverses the roles. A hydrogen atom from HCl has no lone pair to donate. It is the nitrogen atom in $\text{NH}_3$ that donates its lone pair to the $\text{H}^+$ to form a dative covalent bond.
options.C: Incorrect. The angles are different. $\text{NH}_3$ is pyramidal ($107^{\circ}$) because the lone pair repels strongly. $\text{NH}_4^+$ is tetrahedral ($109.5^{\circ}$) because the lone pair is gone.
options.D: Correct. Both $\text{NH}_4^+$ and $\text{CH}_4$ have 4 bonding pairs and no lone pairs around the central atom. Both are tetrahedral with a bond angle of $109.5^{\circ}$, so the H-N-H angle matches the H-C-H angle.
